INSERT INTO valuation_daily (instrument_id, trade_date, pe_ttm, pb_mrq, source, fetched_at, data_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{it.instrumentId}, #{it.tradeDate}, #{it.peTtm}, #{it.pbMrq}, #{it.source}, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), 'ACCEPTED', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
ON CONFLICT (instrument_id, trade_date) DO UPDATE SET pe_ttm = excluded.pe_ttm, pb_mrq = excluded.pb_mrq, source = excluded.source, fetched_at = excluded.fetched_at, data_status = excluded.data_status, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
